name: OpenAI Agents SDK
what: A lightweight Python framework for building agents and multi-agent workflows. It covers agents with tools and handoffs, guardrails, human-in-the-loop, sessions, tracing, sandbox agents and voice/realtime agents. It works with OpenAI's APIs and, per the README, 100+ other LLMs. A JS/TS version exists too. MIT licensed.
who: Python developers building their own agents who want a small, well-documented framework.

setup.code:
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install openai-agents

setup.text: Set OPENAI_API_KEY and run a first agent:
setup.code:
from agents import Agent, Runner

agent = Agent(name="Assistant", instructions="You are a helpful assistant")
result = Runner.run_sync(agent, "Write a haiku about recursion in programming.")
print(result.final_output)

prompts: Build a triage agent with the OpenAI Agents SDK that hands off to a billing agent or a support agent.
Add an input guardrail that blocks requests unrelated to our product.
Connect my agent to a local MCP server and list the tools it can see.
